newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of Tricom shares to be suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Tricom shares to be suspended.

text.p: Trading of Tricom Holdings Ltd shares will be suspended on Tuesday following the close of China Strategic Holdings Ltd's cash offer, which resulted in less than 25 percent of Tricom remaining in public hands.

The company said in a statement that China Strategic held a total 219.71 million shares, or 96 percent of Tricom, as at the close of the cash offer on Monday, leaving only four percent of Tricom in public hands.

In order to maintain Tricom's listing, arrangements will be made to ensure 25 percent of Tricom are held in public hands as soon as practicable, including placing down China Strategic's stake with independent third parties, the statement said.
In September, China Strategic's wholly-owned Sifford Ltd sid it would make a cash offer for Tricom shares at HK$1.20 each after it bought 37 percent of Tricom.
Tricom shares ended at HK$1.20 on Monday.
